Chat request with a tool definition; assistant responds with a tool call

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What is the weather in San Francisco?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"tool_choice\":\"auto\",\"tools\":[{\"function\":{\"description\":\"Get the current weather for a given location\",\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"location\":{\"description\":\"The city and state, e.g. San Francisco, CA\",\"type\":\"string\"},\"unit\":{\"description\":\"The temperature unit to use\",\"enum\":[\"celsius\",\"fahrenheit\"],\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"location\"],\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"function\"}]}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(req: _req)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].message().toolCalls() as Any)
debugPrint(result.choices().message().toolCalls() as Any)
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].finishReason() as Any)
```
